title: The note
starting_code:
# Find the wrong move and fix it!
wizard.move_up()
wizard.move_left()
wizard.move_down()
wizard.move_down()
hints: Look at the first line below the comment.
If you move right first, your wizard will walk into the fence. Which way should you go instead?
Change the first action to the `move_left` method so your wizard goes left instead of right.
intro: I wrote a program on a note to walk to that spot by the little fence pen, but one of the moves is wrong! Can you read my comment, find the wrong move, and fix it?
outro: You fixed it! Sometimes code does not work on the first try, but we can always read it, fix it, and try again.
learned: Now you know what a comment is, and that a note in a program can tell you what to do.
